$ .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/coverage tests/core tests/dsl -q -k "not llm and not openai" --ignore=tests/coverage/test_bedrock_coverage.py --ignore=tests/coverage/test_cohere_coverage.py

Friendly ping: this is ready for review whenever someone has a moment. Happy to adjust anything.
